recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants to clarify the Jira resolution wording, which says single-quote even though the issue description, source grammar, and related evidence point to the FHIRPath-style backtick delimiter.
issue_request: FHIR-39282 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction reporting that FML allowed both backticks and double quotes for delimited identifiers while FHIRPath only uses backticks; the actionable request was to remove the double-quoted delimited-identifier option.
initial_application: Git commit 4988dd04f338d63595d004d52ccfb55c8dc9aa60 directly applied FHIR-39282 by removing the double-quoted alternative from images/mapping.g4's DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER lexer rule. The earlier same-change-family FHIR-25286 commit 54fc90739e2cf48503811483f3cf7ffa8c5a5ce6 had already updated the mapping-language prose and examples.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes mapping-language.html in the built page hierarchy, and publish.ini publishes mapping.g4. A later grammar cleanup, db673c36e89b5e3fe2475c105a43503c5c7ab5e9, retained the backtick-only DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER rule while keeping DOUBLE_QUOTED_STRING only for FML-specific string constructs. FHIR-I WGM minutes record the FHIR-39282 decision, and the earlier Zulip discussion explains the rationale for avoiding double-quoted identifiers.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current images/mapping.g4 DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER rule is backtick-only, and source/mapping-language.html describes and illustrates backtick escaping rather than double-quoted escaping.
